reason: I post in our apartment WhatsApp group or ask a neighbour before I let anyone unfamiliar into my house -- I don't go looking in an app for this. The pay-on-delivery protection sounds fair, but it doesn't replace someone I know actually vouching for the person.
objection: You're telling me the number of real bookings near me is still small while you onboard the first batch -- so basically nobody around me has actually used this yet. That's exactly the kind of unknown person my neighbours warn each other about.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three people in my own building or WhatsApp group had actually booked someone through it and said it went fine, I'd give it a try.
